description: Run the configured lint command on a single file and return pass/fail + output tail. Respects the lintEnabled flag and lintCommand in .cpfs/config-mcp.json. Parity with the extension's post-edit lint hook (exposed here as an on-demand tool).

file.description: Relative file path to lint (the {file} token in lintCommand is replaced with this).

name: cpfs_lint_file
